preconditions.description: The number of ribbons n is between 1 and 750 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 and all(c in 'ab' for c in s) for s in greetings)
preconditions.description: Each greeting is a non-empty string consisting only of characters 'a' and 'b'.
All greetings in the input are distinct.
The total length of all greetings does not exceed 10,000,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The number of selected ribbon indices equals the maximum size printed.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= idx <= n for idx in selected_indices)
postconditions.description: All selected indices are valid ribbon numbers between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: all(greetings[i-1] not in greetings[j-1] and greetings[j-1] not in greetings[i-1] for i in selected_indices for j in selected_indices if i != j)
postconditions.description: For every pair of distinct selected ribbons, neither greeting is a substring of the other.

postconditions.expression: not any(all(greetings[i-1] not in greetings[j-1] and greetings[j-1] not in greetings[i-1] for i in candidate for j in candidate if i != j) for candidate in (set(range(1, n+1)) for _ in [0]) if len(candidate) > len(selected_indices))
postconditions.description: The selected set is of maximum possible size; no larger subset of ribbons satisfies the stylish condition.
